bools.name: dgfBarbNoPrime
bools.comment: Barbarian prose (capture p. 23): no prime requisite - barbarians never gain an experience bonus

bools.name: dgfBarbNotLawful
bools.comment: Barbarian prose (capture p. 23): barbarians cannot be lawful; humans and korobokuru only

bools.name: dgfBarbFighterTables
bools.comment: Barbarian prose (capture p. 23): the fighter combat and saving throw tables; any weapons and armor

bools.name: dgfBarbMagicHatred
bools.comment: Barbarian prose (capture p. 24): at low levels no magical items, only a few at higher levels - the Table 15 ladder lifts the restrictions

bools.name: dgfBarbNoXpForItems
bools.comment: Barbarian prose (capture p. 24): no experience for discovering or possessing magical items

bools.name: dgfBarbXpForDestroying
bools.comment: Barbarian prose (capture p. 24): destroying a magical item earns its full experience value

bools.name: dgfBarbWuJenFoes
bools.comment: Barbarian prose (capture p. 24): at low levels wu jen and spirit folk are deadly foes; even at high levels viewed with suspicion

bools.name: dgfBarbClimbSmoothHalf
bools.comment: Barbarian capabilities (capture p. 24): climb trees and natural cliffs per Table 16; smooth surfaces at one-half the listed chance

bools.name: dgfBarbHideUnfamiliarHalf
bools.comment: Barbarian capabilities (capture p. 24): hide in familiar natural surroundings per Table 16; unfamiliar terrain at one-half

bools.name: dgfBarbBackProtFreeAttack
bools.comment: Barbarian capabilities (capture p. 24): a detected rear attack loses its bonuses and the barbarian gets a free attack at the end of the round, not counting against his normal attacks

bools.name: dgfSteppeNomads
bools.comment: Steppeland prose (capture p. 26): roving nomads, masters of the horse - leather tents, migratory herds, no agriculture (the capture prints hone and tells; the 2018 print reads horse and tents clean)

bools.name: dgfForestVillages
bools.comment: Forest prose (capture p. 26): small permanent villages - the women raise crops, the men hunt and fish

bools.name: dgfJungleVillages
bools.comment: Jungle prose (capture p. 26): permanent villages - gathering jungle plants, hunting wild animals and fishing (the capture prints hulling; read as hunting)

bools.name: dgfBarbOutsiders
bools.comment: Barbarian prose (capture p. 26): automatic outsiders - the lowest caste, never roll on Table 38; clan membership required

bools.name: dgfHordeShamans
bools.comment: The Barbarian Horde (capture p. 26): witch doctors or shamans as appropriate - helpful spells but prone to meddling and fomenting unrest

bools.name: dgfHordePurposeFixed
bools.comment: The Barbarian Horde (capture p. 26): one clearly stated purpose, unchangeable - changing it or weeks of inactivity disbands the horde

bools.name: dgfHordeWeeksEqualLevel
bools.comment: The Barbarian Horde (capture p. 26): holds together for weeks equal to the leader level; each week beyond needs a successful appeal reaction check

bools.name: dgfHordeSuccessLegacy
bools.comment: The Barbarian Horde (capture pp. 26-27): a successful campaign disbands to a hero welcome - a new horde raises easily; disaster means no second horde and a poor welcome home

bools.name: dgfBushiMasterless
bools.comment: Bushi prose (capture p. 27): masterless warriors - mercenaries, bandits, highwaymen, wanderers; mostly low birth choosing the way of the warrior

bools.name: dgfBushiStrPrime
bools.comment: Bushi prose (capture p. 27): Strength is the prime requisite - Str 14 or greater earns the 10 percent bonus (the printed 550-to-605 example); any alignment or race

bools.name: dgfBushiFighterTables
bools.comment: Bushi prose (capture p. 27): the fighter combat and saving throw tables; any armor and weapon

bools.name: dgfBushiNinjaHonor
bools.comment: Bushi prose (capture p. 27): ninja preferred weapons lose honor - but not as much as a samurai

bools.name: dgfBushiFighterBonuses
bools.comment: Bushi prose (capture p. 27): high Strength and Constitution earn the normal fighter bonuses

tables.name: dgfT14Grid
tables.comment: the Table 14 barbarian advancement grid (capture p. 24)
col_comments: the experience column: the upper xp bound of each level, 4,000 at 1st doubling to 1,900,000 at 11th (capture p. 24).
the accumulated d12 dice column: one die per level through 8th, then held at 8 (capture p. 24).
the hit-point bonus column: the printed 8-plus-N cells - 4 per level beyond 8th: 0 through 8th, then 4, 8, 12 (capture p. 24).
tables.audit_comment: the Table 14 grid: the level xp bounds and the accumulated dice plus bonus (capture p. 24)

tables.name: dgfT15Grid
tables.comment: the Table 15 barbarian bonuses grid (capture p. 25)
col_comments: the bonus code column: potions 1, weapons 2, armor 3, half xp 4, misc items 5, full xp 6, scrolls 7, save two 8, horde 9, save three 10 (capture p. 25).
the save bonus column: +1 at level 4, +2 at 10, +3 at 12, zero elsewhere (capture p. 25).
tables.audit_comment: the Table 15 grid: the level ladder of lifted restrictions with the save bonuses (capture p. 25)

tables.name: dgfT16Grid
tables.comment: the Table 16 barbarian capabilities grid (capture p. 25)
col_comments: the climb column: 85 percent at 1st rising one per level to 95 at 11th (capture p. 25).
the hide column: 25 at 1st rising in 6-7 percent steps to 93 at 11th (capture p. 25).
the back protection column: 5 per level, 5 to 55 (capture p. 25).
the detect illusion column: 5 per level, 5 to 55 - capped at 75 by the prose (capture p. 25).
the detect magic column: 30 at 1st rising 5 per level to 80 at 11th (capture p. 25).
tables.audit_comment: the Table 16 grid: climb, hide, back protection, detect illusion and detect magic across levels 1-11 (capture p. 25)

tables.name: dgfT17Grid
tables.comment: the Table 17 bushi advancement grid (capture p. 27)
col_comments: the experience column: the upper xp bound of each level, 1,500 at 1st to 1,250,000 at 12th (capture p. 27).
the accumulated d10 dice column: one per level through 9th, then held at 9 (capture p. 27).
the hit-point bonus column: the printed 9-plus-N cells - 2 per level beyond 9th: 0 through 9th, then 2, 4, 6 (capture p. 27).
tables.audit_comment: the Table 17 grid: the level xp bounds and the accumulated dice plus bonus (capture p. 27)

table_checks.note: the T14 level-9 row - eight dice plus the 4 bonus (capture p. 24)
the T16 detect magic - 25 base plus 5 per level lands 30 at 1st (capture p. 25)
the T15 horde bonus at level 11 with no save bump (capture p. 25)
the T17 level-10 row - nine dice plus the 2 bonus (capture p. 27)
the horde max weeks - 1 1/2 times the level, the 3-over-2 pair (capture p. 26)
the barbarian Con bonus doubles the bushi hp-beyond step at their thresholds (capture pp. 23, 27)
the bushi AC step - one per five levels (capture p. 27)
the territory proficiency counts - 16, 18 and 16 (capture p. 26)

banner.title: THE BARBARIAN AND BUSHI, printed capture pp. 23-28 - the OA class run opens
banner.provenance: verified against capture pp. 23-28 of the oa.pdf OCR session (single Mistral-OCR capture; cites are capture pages), with the 2018-print settling capture consulted for the contested horde cell: the first capture prints 1112 times the leader level - the 2018 print reads 1 1/2 times CLEAN; pinned as the 3-over-2 pair. Other settled garbles: hone/tells read as horse/tents, hulling as hunting, five as live - prose only, the numbers read clean. The Table 15 bonus rows pin as a coded grid (each lifted restriction its own code const) with the save bonuses as their own column. This round also carries the R618 v3 adjudication amendment folded in (comment-only, no data changes).
